name: Leon Cole
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember unlocking my shop with my landlord beside me.” On Saturday, near the steps at Pier Beach, Leon watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: I own the studio. I called the offer independence before asking who buys the empty hours.
appearance: Leon is easy to recognize by a smooth side part with one rebellious curl and a straight nose and deep-set eyes. Usually dressed in a boxy denim jacket with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand, Leon looks down for a moment before saying something difficult when listening.
personality: Leon has a long memory for unfair prices and a short one for small insults. Leon can get along perfectly well with an enemy provided the account between them is clear.
agenda: To price the empty hours openly.
family: Taylor Chan is Leon’s second cousin. Leon picks the meeting place. Taylor sets the time to leave. It lets them stay close without turning a family visit into the loss of an entire day. They have both had stretches when that distinction mattered. Asked about *The first delivery fee*, Taylor says, “I suggested a subscription. The residents asked what happens to the fee when they go into hospital.”
connections: Drew Lai. They compare contracts across the salon and barber counters.

reactions.situation: A regular cancels the week's most valuable appointment
reactions.response: Leon revises the week's numbers with the cancellation included before making any promise.

reactions.situation: An unfamiliar person asks for directions but cannot read the street signs
reactions.response: Leon finds out what the destination actually looks like to the traveler and gives directions in those terms.
